newsitem.title: USA: Sysco Corp says will draw $150 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Sysco Corp says will draw $150 mln debt.

text.p: Sysco Corp said Wednesday it will draw, in two separate offerings, the remaining $150 million of the $500 million shelf debt registration filed on June 6, 1995.
The company said it has sold $50 million of 7.16% debentures due April 15, 2027, bearing interest paid semi-annually, in an offering scheduled to close on April 25, 1997.

The company said that priced at par, the debentures are unsecured, redeemable at the option of the holder on April 15, 2007, but otherwise not redeemable prior to maturity, and not subject to any sinking fund requirement.
The company said they are rated A1 by Moody's Investors Service and AA minus by Standard & Poor's.
The company also said it has sold $100 million of 7.25% senior notes due April 15, 2007, bearing interest paid semi-annually, in an offering scheduled to close on April 25, 1997.
The company said that priced at 99.611% of par, the notes are unsecured, not redeemable prior to maturity and not subject to any sinking fund requirement.
The company said the senior notes are rated AA minus by Standard & Poor's and the company anticipates receiving a rating of A1 from Moody's Investors Service.

The company said Merrill Lynch & Co acted as underwriter of the debentures, while Chase Securities Inc, Goldman, Sachs & Co and UBS Securities acted as underwriters of the notes. The company said proceeds from both offerings will be used entirely to pay down outstanding floating-rate commercial paper and overnight borrowings.
